name: Salma
overview: Salma, also known as Salmon, is a significant figure in the biblical genealogies as the son of Caleb and the father of Boaz, linking him directly to the lineage of Joseph. Scripture highlights his role as the father of Bethlehem and the progenitor of several clans, including the Netophathites and the house of Joab, emphasizing his importance in the tribal structure of Israel. The genealogies in Ruth and Matthew confirm his place in the Messianic line, showing the continuity of God's providential plan through his descendants.
